newsitem.title: USA: Continental tops frequent flier survey.
newsitem.headline: Continental tops frequent flier survey.

text.p: A passenger survey released Wednesday ranked Continental Airlines the top carrier in customer satisfaction for domestic flights over 500 miles for the second year in a row.
America West, a unit of America West Holdings Corp, was ranked the top carrier for short-haul domestic flights, taking that ranking from last year's winner Northwest Airlines.
Frequent Flyer magazine and J.D. Power and Associates surveyed 2,500 frequent travellers in January. Respondents were asked to evaluate three trips completed in the last six months.
